      "text": "The image shows a poll from a messaging app (likely Discord or Telegram) aimed at a gaming community, most likely a **Minecraft** or **Garry\u0027s Mod** server.\n\nHere is the translation and breakdown of the text:\n\n### **Translation:**\n**Main Question:** \"Let’s add a plugin for custom cool craftable items for the vibe (cigarettes, kakikola [funny name for Coca-Cola], etc.)\"\n\n**Poll Options:**\n1.  **Да** (Yes)\n2.  **Нет (я скучный)** (No (I\u0027m boring))\n\n---\n\n### **Key Terms Explained:**\n*   **Плагин (Plugin):** A piece of software added to a game server to give it new features or items.\n*   **Кастом (Custom):** Items that are not in the original game but are created by the server owners.\n*   **Крафтабельные (Craftable):** Items that players can make themselves using materials within the game.\n*   **Для вайба (For the vibe):** This refers to adding items that don\u0027t necessarily have a gameplay advantage but make the atmosphere (the \"vibe\") of the server more fun or realistic.\n*   **Какикола (Kakikola):** This is a humorous, slangy misspelling of \"Coca-Cola.\" It combines \"Coca\" with the Russian word *kaka* (meaning \"poop\" or just something silly/gross in a childish way) to create a parody name for the drink.\n\n### **Overall Meaning:**\nThe person who posted this is asking the community if they should install a mod that lets players craft decorative/roleplay items like cigarettes or parody sodas just to make the server more fun and \"chill.\" The poll is \"biased\" because the \"No\" option jokingly labels whoever clicks it as \"boring.\"",
